submission.text: We did some work outside of this to migrate app-monitor from using app-issue-tracker to using swarm-manager. Not sure how complete/verified that migration is, but it likely affects the deprecation work completion status. Not sure where else app-issue-tracker is still used, as I think app-monitor was the primary place. Probably worth seeing how it was done there, verifying its accuracy and seeing what remaining work needs to be done (should ideally be a hard cutover with absolutely no compatability/legacy/dead code to the app-issue-tracker integration), and suggesting applying that same pattern to every other scenario that still integrates with app-issue-tracker
